plotSections.title: Searching Inventories for the Lich's Phylactery
bullets: The party realizes the lich's phylactery could be a mundane item and starts checking their own inventories for suspicious objects.
Ord has a Helix medallion and an origami beetle, possibly taken from someone's desk. The beetle may hold a message, and Ord sets out to inspect it.
Sylan has a fancy gold bar he knows nothing about, plus a broken longsword from the crashed skyship in the swamp.
The party worries they may need to check every coin. Sylan doubts they picked up coins from their fights with the Lich.
Gerk asks whether a phylactery could be a fly or a grain of sand. The table agrees it must be an object, and Sylan notes it is normally an item important to the mage before becoming a lich.
